stackDivergence.rationale: Original source responsibilities retain actual RTL/UNO owners and contracts. omittedResponsibilities: The native clipboard registry/helper slice does not implement the legacy compound storage engine or supply a positive native XStorage provider; its earlier scoped branch coverage gap remains open.
Independent native compiled module differential, physical ABI/allocator/mutex/thread lifetime and runtime shutdown are unqualified.
Complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/package/desktop/mobile UI import-export acceptance remains unfinished; existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery choices are retained.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The original header and implementation or inline responsibilities share a native basename. This explicit module boundary retains their distinct import identities and the same actual receiver/owner while the original source contracts stay mapped to the pinned translation unit.
